body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> JVC presented its in-ear premium Black series headphone line 'HA-FXC80' during CES 2010, which combines advanced materials and JVC's Micro-HD driver with a unique design that offers comfort and a secure fit.

The headphone's performance advantage begins with the use of JVC's Micro-HD driver, a design that places the driver unit in the ear canal as opposed to conventional designs that place the driver in the housing outside the ear canal. As a result, sound is delivered directly to the ear without diffused reflections for clarity and improved isolation from outside noise. Performance is further enhanced through the use of a carbon housing and carbon diaphragm. Together, these innovations deliver crisp, clean sound and solid bass. The gold-plated iPhone-compatible slim plug and 3.94 ft (1.2 m) pure copper cord minimize loss in sound quality.

The headphone's unique Tri-form design, with its triangular black housing, allows the option of wearing the headphone with the cord below the ear or turning the housing so that the cord can be easily wrapped over the top and behind the ear. Detachable soft ear loops are included to secure over-the-ear placement of the cord. A snug, secure in-ear fit with minimal sound leakage is guaranteed with three sizes of soft silicon earpieces included. Completing the lineup of accessories is a handy carrying pouch.
The new JVC HA-FXC80 headphones will be available for $59.99 in January 2010.
